caption: Figure 3 : (a) I-JEPA performs single-stage latent prediction using contextual representations encoded from visible patches. (b) CascadeJEPA introduces spatially coupled cascaded prediction, where the first stage learns spatially structured contextual representations through full-grid encoding, and the second stage uses them to guide latent prediction via cross-attention. This unidirectional coupling promotes richer patch-level interactions while largely preserving the original I-JEPA architecture.
